chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Kazzaz, from Ghayath ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the extra finger: if it is cut off, its compensation is one-third of the wergild of the healthy (finger).
ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for losing an extra finger according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific financial compensation (diyah) for the amputation of an extra finger, ruling it at one-third of a standard finger's value. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential approach to 'ziyadah' (anatomical additions), distinguishing their compensation from primary digits based on their functional and structural significance in bodily integrity.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya Al Khazzaz, from Ghayas Bin Ibrahim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the excessive finger when it is cut-off, is one-third of the wergild of the healthy (finger)’.
